report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Support gets what was under way and how long each step took, the version, your browser and your settings. None of your words, files, names or keys go with it.
report.wordsHint: Only if support needs them to see what went wrong.
report.json: All of it, as support reads it
report.written: The report is copied: paste it into your message.
report.linked: Link copied. It stops working after a week, and you can stop it sooner among your links.
report.refused: Your organisation's rules keep this report on this device.
report.failed: That didn't work. Try again, or save it as a file.
report.subject: {name} {version}: a problem
report.mailBody: The report is on your clipboard: paste it here.
report.stage.compact: Summing up the task so far
report.unsent.held: Not sent: your last request is still under way.
report.unsent.unreached: Not sent: your request didn't get through.
report.unsent.loading: Not sent: what sends it is still loading.
report.unsent.unloaded: Not sent: what sends it didn't load.
report.takeIntro: A report someone sent you becomes a stand-in: the same setup, with filler words of the same length, to restore in a new profile.
report.paste: Paste the report, or the page its link shows
report.standInSaved: Saved. Restore it in a new profile, from Your data. Not in it: {missing}.
report.missing.own: the sender's own services and addresses
report.missing.device: this device's own choices, such as the monthly limit
